post.author: Tiesa be cenzūros
post.text: „Pabėgėliai gauna didesnes išmokas nei mūsų pensininkai. Kas čia vyksta?“
post.translation: “Refugees get bigger benefits than our pensioners. What is going on?”

claim.headline: It's not false, but it's misleading.
claim.text: Refugees receive higher benefits than pensioners
claim.explanation: It compares a one-time settling-in grant with a monthly pension. Monthly support for refugees is lower than the average pension.
claim.evidence: Municipal support rules and pension statistics: the monthly amounts don't support the comparison.

origin.headline: It started in Russian, four and a half hours earlier.

travel.headline: In three days it was copied 29 times, mostly in Lithuanian.

narrative.headline: Yes. It feeds a growing storyline about refugees and welfare.
narrative.name: Refugees get bigger benefits than pensioners
